Stone Alternatives gives you options to coordinate the wall with the floor, doors and paint. strings.أي جدار تختار في المدخل؟: Which wall do you choose at the entrance?
strings.شوف المدخل من زاوية الدخول للبيت، وحدد ا: See the entrance from the angle of entry to the house, and select the wall you want to accentuate. You can choose an area next to a console or a clear extension of the corridor, depending on the size and design. Check the door opening, the location of the lights and the power panel, and specify which parts remain available for use and maintenance. If you have a mirror or shelf, indicate where it is and what the installation requirements are before installing Cladding.
strings.شلون تنسّق لون بديل الحجر؟: How do you coordinate the color of the stone alternative?
strings.قارن درجة الخامة مع البلاط والأبواب ولون: Compare the grade of the material with the tiles, doors and surrounding paint color. If the place has more than one color or pattern, try a quieter option so that the composition is balanced. See an actual sample in the lighting of the place, and see the size of the pattern on a larger area if available. The image of the product helps you choose an initial direction, but the color and appearance of the surface need to be reviewed on nature.
strings.في الممر، الحواف والفتحات تستحق اهتمامك: In the corridor, the edges and openings deserve your attention.
strings.الممر فيه حركة يومية، وغالبًا تكون تفاصي: The passageway has daily movement, and the wall details are often close to the eye. Ask Win Starts Stone Alternatives and Win Ends, a sheath that distributes connections around doors and switches. Agree to address the corner and confluence cladding with the Minister and doorknob, and review the thickness of the system and its impact on the existing details. Clarity of the halots before shearing helps coordinate the result, especially if cladding leaves cover only part of the wall.
strings.نراجع استواء السطح وتماسكه وآثار الرطوبة: We review the leveling of the surface, its consistency and the effects of moisture or flaking. If the wall needs repair or removal of incoherent parts, it must be determined by the processing. The method of installation depends on the product, the surface, installation instructions, and any moisture problem need to be identified and addressed before cladding is adopted. Covering the wall alone is what is considered a remedy for the problem.
strings.هل كل بديل حجر يناسب نفس الاستخدام؟: Is each stone alternative suitable for the same use?
strings.اسم بديل الحجر يشمل منتجات تختلف في التر: The name stone alternatives includes products that differ in composition and specifications. Therefore, the suitability of the material for a wet or near-heat place or for external use is determined by the product specification and its installation system. Ask for clarification of the name of the material and the method of care, and make sure that the choice suits the room and the actual use before the agreement.
strings.شنو لازم يشمله عرض التنفيذ؟: What needs to be included in the implementation offer?
strings.راجع نوع الخامة ومساحة العمل وتجهيز الجد: See the type of material, work space, wall processing, shears, edges and installation method. Also explain if old finishing, electrical modification or mirror installation and shelves are included. Price and duration are determined by materials, site condition and required details, and compare offers are clearer for what the scope of work is specific.
